text:
I read all nine tracked files. There is no `astro.config.*`, no images and no other pages. Findings are ordered by severity. Line numbers are within each file. ## High: blocks indexing or AI visibility 1. **Every page canonicalises to the homepage.** `src/layouts/Base.astro:8` hardcodes `href="https://harbor.example/"`. `/moorings` and `/contact` tell search engines to consolidate into `/`. - Fix: build it from the page URL, `new URL(Astro.url.pathname, Astro.site)`. - This needs `site` set in an `astro.config.mjs`, which doesn't exist (see 9). 2. **The default robots meta suppresses snippets.** `Base.astro:9` falls back to `max-snippet:0`. Any page that doesn't pass `robots` gets no text snippets in Google, and AI answer features generally honour it too. - Fix: default to `index,follow,max-snippet:-1,max-image-preview:large`. 3. **AI search crawlers are blocked.** `public/robots.txt:4-8` disallows `OAI-SearchBot` (ChatGPT search) and `PerplexityBot`. Those two are the bots that let you appear and be cited in those products, so the site can't show up there. - Fix: remove both blocks, or change them to `Allow: /`. Only keep a block if you deliberately want to opt out of those engines. 4. **The contact page is `noindex` but listed in the sitemap.** `src/pages/contact.astro:4` sets `robots="noindex"`, while `public/sitemap.xml:5` lists `/contact`. The signals conflict, and for a harbour office the contact page should be indexable (phone number, local intent). - Fix: drop `robots="noindex"`. If you really want it hidden, remove it from the sitemap instead. ## Medium: structured data is broken 5. **The FAQ schema is invalid.** `src/data/faq.json:8` has the key `" "` where `"acceptedAnswer"` should be. The first Question has no answer, so Google rejects the FAQPage and parsers can't read it. - Fix: rename the key to `acceptedAnswer`. 6. **The Article JSON-LD is invalid JSON.** `src/pages/moorings.astro:9` has a trailing comma after `"headline"`, so parsers drop the whole block. - Fix: remove the comma. - Also, Article is the wrong type for a prices page and lacks `author`, `datePublished` and `image`. Use `WebPage`, or `Product`/`Offer` for the £40/night price. - Better still, build it with `JSON.stringify` and `set:html`, as `index.astro:8` does, so it can't be malformed by hand. 7. **The FAQ exists only as JSON-LD.** `src/pages/index.astro:8` injects it, but the questions and answers never appear in the visible HTML. Google requires FAQ markup to match visible content, and LLMs extract from visible text. - Fix: render the Q&A from `faq.json` in the page body, for example as `

`/`

` or `

`. 8. **There is no entity markup.** Nothing describes the harbour as a business. - Fix: add `Organization` or `LocalBusiness` JSON-LD in `Base.astro` with name, address, phone (01326 000000, from `contact.astro:6`), opening hours and `sameAs` links. ## Medium: config and head 9. **There is no `astro.config.mjs`.** - No `site` is set, so absolute URLs and canonicals can't be generated. - `@astrojs/preact` is installed (`package.json:10`) but never registered, so `Newsletter.jsx` won't build. - `@astrojs/sitemap` isn't installed, so the sitemap is hand-maintained. - Fix: add the config with `site`, `integrations: [preact(), sitemap()]`, and delete the static `sitemap.xml`. 10. **The head is missing basics.** `Base.astro:5-10` has no ``, no ``, no Open Graph or Twitter tags (`og:title`, `og:description`, `og:url`, `og:image`), and no favicon. 11. **The sitemap and robots point at a placeholder domain.** `harbor.example` appears in `sitemap.xml:3-5`, `robots.txt:10` and `Base.astro:8`. Replace it with the real domain once it's known. ## Low: content and copy 12. **Two pages compete for the same topic, and the content is thin.** `index.astro:5-7` (title "Harbor moorings in Cornwall", H1 "Moorings in Falmouth") and `moorings.astro:5-7` (title "Moorings and prices") both target moorings. Each has one sentence of body copy. - Give the homepage a broader harbour-overview purpose. - Make `/moorings` the detailed page: sizes, prices, how to book, season dates, water taxi times. - Spell the name consistently: "Harbor" (`index.astro:5`, `package.json:2`) versus "harbour" (`contact.astro:4`). - Make the titles specific, and put "Falmouth" in them. 13. **The descriptions are generic.** `index.astro:5` ("Book a mooring in Falmouth harbour.") and `moorings.astro:5` are very short. Aim for about 120–155 characters with concrete facts, such as prices from £40 a night or the water taxi season. 14. **The newsletter form lacks `name`/`action`.** `src/components/Newsletter.jsx:2` has an `` with no `name` and a form with no `action`, so it can't submit without JavaScript. Also, `client:load` on `moorings.astro:11` ships Preact for a trivial form. Prefer `client:visible` or plain HTML. 15. **Optional: add `llms.txt`.** A short `public/llms.txt` that summarises the site and links to key pages helps some AI tools, though it's not a ranking factor. I can apply the fixes for 1–9 if you want. Items 11–13 need real values from you (domain, copy, address).
